factors.label: Flood risk
factors.good: Dry ground around the building: equipment and access stay safe.
factors.bad: Flood-prone location: inverters and access are at risk.

factors.label: Roof sunlight
factors.good: Well-lit roof: little shade and a good orientation.
factors.bad: Shaded or poorly oriented roof: much less sunlight on the panels.

factors.label: Roof size
factors.good: A large usable roof: one installation, lower cost per kW.
factors.bad: Little usable space: small, costly installations.

factors.label: On-site demand
factors.good: A tall building uses what its roof produces.
factors.bad: A low building exports most of what it produces.

excl_names: on roofs without enough clear, sunlit space
